name: Esha Media Research Limited
about: Esha Media Research Limited provides media monitoring, social listening, and consumer intelligence solutions in India. The company operates Clipbyte for media monitoring, which safeguards brand, comprehends public sentiment, and tracks competitor influence for large corporations, government bodies, film associations, and sports organizers. It also provides stock market vigilance, such as rumor impact assessment, conversation impact analysis, and real-time market updates; real-time alerts, crisis management, and strategic planning for corporate image monitoring; and tracking of brand visibility at live sports comprising real-time brand monitoring, player association analysis, exposure insights, and reporting. In addition, the company offers media spend audits consisting of ad spend verification, ad placement confirmation, allocation of budget, audit monitoring, reporting, and analysis; and media transcription and translation, which include video transcription, accessibility, legal team support, multi-language translation, review process, confidentiality and security, and customizable services. Further, it provides data management services, including organization, storage solutions, and access. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.
